name: interface-localization-and-bidirectionality
intent: Engineer locale and direction behavior across text, layout, controls, formatting, assets, and assistive semantics while preserving human language review.
successCondition: Stop when locale formatting, LTR and RTL layout, mixed text, controls, accessibility, screenshots, and human review gates pass.
inputs: interface routes components and content catalog
target locales scripts and direction rules
human-reviewed translations and visual acceptance matrix
outputs: locale visual interaction and human-review evidence
operations: bind locale formatting pluralization and direction
adapt layout navigation icons and mixed-direction text
test keyboard assistive semantics screenshots and human-reviewed language
preconditions: target locales and direction rules are explicit
positiveTriggers: Add locale-aware and bidirectional interface behavior.
Verify RTL LTR mixed text formatting controls and visual layout.
negativeTriggers: Publish machine translation without human review.
Mirror directional icons or data semantics indiscriminately.
failureModes: stop publication when human translation review is absent
retain logical order when visual mirroring would change meaning
exclusions: does not certify cultural appropriateness automatically
does not publish or mutate translation services
terminationConditions: Stop when locale formatting, LTR and RTL layout, mixed text, controls, accessibility, screenshots, and human review gates pass.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-muse route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
